name: Choco Nut Cookies
ingredients_raw: Refined Wheat Flour(Maida), Sugar, Edible Vegetable Oil(Palm), Choco Chips(5%) [Sugar, Edible Vegetable Fat, Cocoa Solids, Dextrose, Emulsifiers (INS 322 from Soy, INS 476), Nature Identical & Artificial Flavouring Substances (Vanilla, Chocolate)], Cashew Bits (4%), Cocoa Powder, Milk Solids, Leavening Agents (INS 503 ii, INS 500 i), Emulsifier INS 322 from Soy), lodised Salt, Artificial Flavouring Substance (Vanillin). Allergen Advice: Contains Wheat, Milk, Soy & Nut.
